label: 屋顶
description: 追加 roof(...)：footprint 之上的 flat/shed/gable/hip/gambrel/mansard/pyramid 屋顶（平/单坡/双坡/四坡/谷仓/孟莎/金字塔）。当 prompt 提到 屋顶 / 屋面 / 坡屋顶 / roof 时使用。
description-en: Append `roof(...)` — flat/shed/gable/hip/gambrel/mansard/pyramid roof over a footprint. Use for roof, pitched roof, gable, hip, gambrel, mansard.

inputs.name: type
inputs.label: 类型
inputs.description: flat / shed / gable / hip / gambrel / mansard / pyramid
inputs.description-en: flat / shed / gable / hip / gambrel / mansard / pyramid.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: 屋脊高
inputs.description: 屋脊相对底面高度（非 flat）

inputs.name: overhang
inputs.label: 出檐
inputs.description: 出檐宽度（米）；eave/verge 未给时对两向通用
inputs.description-en: Overhang (meters); used for both directions when eave/verge unset.

inputs.name: eave_overhang
inputs.label: 檐口出挑
inputs.description: 檐口出挑（短边/坡向，米）；0=沿用 overhang
inputs.description-en: Eave overhang along the span/slope sides; 0 = fall back to overhang.

inputs.name: verge_overhang
inputs.label: 山墙出挑
inputs.description: 山墙出挑（屋脊/长边，米）；0=沿用 overhang
inputs.description-en: Verge overhang along the ridge sides; 0 = fall back to overhang.

inputs.name: coping_width
inputs.label: 压顶外挑
inputs.description: flat：女儿墙压顶外挑宽（米）；0=无压顶
inputs.description-en: flat: parapet coping projection; 0 = no coping.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.description: 自定义 id；空 = 自动 roof{n}

outputs.name: geometry
outputs.label: 几何
outputs.description: 追加 roof 行后的 Geometry
